future_tied_minima_order_correction.official_excerpt: 3-1-3-4. When multiple cards leave an area at the same time, the player who owns the card that caused the action to be performed chooses the order in which the cards are placed in the new area. (Example: When "[When Digivolving] Return all of your opponent's Digimon with the highest level to the bottom of the deck in any order" is used to return multiple opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck at the same time, the player who activated this effect chooses the order in which the cards are placed at the bottom of the deck.)

EX13-023.question: What exactly does a "can't (perform XX on) stacked cards" effect mean?
EX13-023.answer:
This means that the effect prevents processing of "(perform XX on) stacked cards."
For example, a "can't trash stacked cards" effect prevents trashing the top stacked cards by (which trashes the top stacked cards) or similar effects, and it prevents trashing the bottom stacked cards by "trash a digivolution card" or similar effects.
However, because the effect only prevents processing "(perform XX on) stacked cards," XX is still permitted to be performed on the Digimon itself, for instance by effects that tell you to "perform XX" on the Digimon.

EX13-023.question: This card has multiple effects that trigger when it's played or when it digivolves. In what order can they be activated?
EX13-023.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

EX13-023.question: What does orientation mean?
EX13-023.answer: It refers to the suspended or unsuspended state of a card.

EX13-069.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
EX13-069.answer:
No, you can't.
If you don't suspend this card, you can't process the part after "after" in this card's [Your Turn] effect.

EX13-069.question:
There are two copies of this card in the battle area.
Can I activate both of their [Your Turn] effects and digivolve one specified card with its cost reduced by the combined amount from both effects?
EX13-069.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that digivolve a card.

official_rules_excerpts.digivolution_completion: 8-1-3-3. The player places the Digimon for the digivolution on top of the chosen card, draws 1 card, and the digivolution process is resolved.
official_rules_excerpts.source_trashing: 4-7-8. When a card with cards stacked under it would be removed from the field, the cards under it are trashed at the same time. (Example: When a Digimon or Tamer would be removed from the battle area, any cards under it are trashed at the same time.)
official_rules_excerpts.simultaneous_next_order: 15-4-3-4. The activation order is determined for effects that trigger simultaneously by choosing the next pending activation effect after each effect has been resolved.
official_rules_excerpts.derived_trigger_priority: 15-4-5-2. A derived triggering effect will activate before previously triggered effects that are pending activation.
official_rules_excerpts.evade: 16-22-1. <Evade> is a keyword effect. By suspending a Digimon with this effect when it would be deleted, this effect prevents the deletion. 16-22-2. <Evade> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")15-8-5
